scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the Saturday morning ride plan for the Waltham goalball clinic while leaving the event and existing paratransit booking unchanged.
Emerging Need: The confirmed pickup is ordinary until a home-block street closure and equipment handoff make the assigned curb a plausible failure point.
Decision Context: The useful preventive step depends on stored The RIDE home-pickup instructions identifying the reliable alternate door and the pre-dispatch channel, not on the alerts alone.
Consequence: If the dispatch package locks before the temporary door note is added, the trip may still run but the driver could follow an inaccessible detour and miss the intended pickup.

parameter.title: Waltham goalball clinic setup
parameter.description: Assist with court setup and beginner drills; bring assigned club materials if handed off before Saturday.
parameter.location: Waltham Recreation Center, 510 Moody Street, Waltham, MA

parameter.subject: The RIDE booking confirmation TR-5K9Q for Aug 15
parameter.body: Reservation TR-5K9Q is confirmed for Saturday, August 15. Pickup window: 6:55 AM-7:15 AM. Origin: 24 College Ave main entrance, Somerville. Destination: Waltham Recreation Center, 510 Moody Street. Fare will be collected from the rider account at boarding.

parameter.content: Coach left the small club ball bag with me, so I’m dropping it at your building Friday evening. It should be the bag you have with you for the Waltham clinic Saturday morning.

parameter.subject: Saturday morning College Ave utility closure near Davis Square
parameter.body: Utility work will close the curb lane and short-term pickup area outside 22-30 College Ave on Saturday, August 15 from 5:30 AM to 9:30 AM. Passenger vehicles will be directed to the temporary Elm Street loading zone. Building pedestrian access will remain open from the Grove Street side while crews occupy the College Ave frontage.

parameter.subject: Pre-dispatch timing for Saturday early trips affected by Somerville closures
parameter.body: The RIDE operations team is flagging Saturday reservations with origins on the College Ave closure block before 8:00 AM. Temporary pickup-door notes for those reservations are being locked into the driver pre-dispatch package at 5:00 PM today. After that package is locked, drivers will see municipal detours but may not have rider-specific door instructions.

parameter.subject: Saturday early-trip pre-dispatch package closed
parameter.body: The pre-dispatch package for Saturday early trips has closed as of 5:00 PM. New pickup-location details received after closure will route to the day-of dispatch queue and may not appear in the assigned driver notes before morning pull-out.
